mandatory_legal_checks: E-Commerce Rules 2020 R.4 — total price must be broken down, showing delivery and handling charges, before purchase
E-Commerce Rules 2020 R.4(4) and R.4(5) — grievance officer; 48 hours to acknowledge, one month to redress
Sale of Goods Act 1930 S.26 — risk passes with property unless otherwise agreed; placing carriage risk on a consumer is hard to defend
CGST Act 2017 S.31 — tax invoice requirements for the shipping charge
